scenarios.scenario: Caller calls create_ticket_order_v5 directly with anon/authenticated key to create orders for another user
scenarios.rationale: Migration revokes execute from public, anon, authenticated and grants only service_role; asserted by isolated PostgreSQL permission checks.

scenarios.scenario: Body-supplied user id spoofs order owner
scenarios.rationale: Route passes p_user_id: authData.user.id only; route tests assert exact auth-derived arguments.

scenarios.scenario: search_path hijack of SECURITY DEFINER function
scenarios.rationale: Function sets search_path = '' ; verified by DB runner.

scenarios.scenario: Retry/replay or provider timeout causes a second PayOS create POST or duplicate order/link
scenarios.rationale: Idempotency + lease logic delegated to v4; PayOS tests assert max one POST with GET fallback; DB concurrency/replay checks pass.

scenarios.scenario: v4 conflict error smuggled into prepare marker to produce misleading 404
scenarios.rationale: Error channels separated; 23505 stays RPC error -> 409; route tests (b)-(f).
